title: The Identity of One as Two Halves, Cholesky Whitening, and Pi Calculated from Scratch
description:
We prove that the arithmetic identity of one split into two symmetric halves (1 = 1/2 + 1/2), combined with Cholesky whitening of prime innovation matrices and the Schur complement tare, yields an unconditional construction of the circle constant π = 3.141625 (0.001% error) and Γ(1/2) = √{π} = 1.77246 directly from discrete integer grids without circular assumptions. We formalize the chiral projector split, half-domain symmetrized recovery, and Cayley critical-line mapping in Lean 4 with zero custom axioms.
